data.statement: A LiberiaLearn Grade 4 learner at mastery can represent a fraction as equal parts of a whole or of a set, write equivalent fractions, and compare fractions with related denominators. Grounded in the MOE Grade 4 Mathematics objectives 'Find parts of a set' and 'Write equivalent fractions' (GRADE-1-6/Math 1-6.pdf, page 42). Comparing fractions is a LiberiaLearn extension, not a Grade 4 MOE objective. This target makes no MOE approval claim.
